refs.Y: The best CD version of "Night at the Opera" by Queen is the 1985 release on the Queen II soundtrack. This version features the original vocals of Freddie Mercury, as well as the iconic performance of the band at the Montreux Jazz Festival in 1975. The sound quality is excellent, and the bonus tracks on the CD include a live performance of the song at the Montreux Jazz Festival, as well as acoustic versions of the song.
